title: Auto Loans: payoff amount, payoff quotes and paying a loan off
content:
# Auto Loans: payoff amount, payoff quotes and paying a loan off

This policy of the Auto Loans product category at PCB governs the payoff amount of an auto loan, payoff quotes, and what happens when a payment reaches or misses the payoff amount. Each product applies its own payoff quote validity and day-count basis.

## Clauses

1. **Payoff amount.** The payoff amount on a date is the principal balance plus the interest accrued through that date plus the fees due.
2. **Payoff quote.** A payoff quote states the payoff amount for a date up to the product's quote-validity period, in calendar days, ahead, together with the per-diem interest. The per-diem interest is the principal balance multiplied by the APR, divided by 100 and by the product's day-count basis, rounded half-up to the cent.
3. **Payment that reaches the payoff amount.** A payment of at least the payoff amount on its credit date posts as a payoff payment, pays fees, interest and principal to zero, and moves the loan, whether active or delinquent, to paid off; the lien release is then started.
4. **Excess.** Any excess is refunded to the payer within 5 business days by the same method it came from.
5. **Shortfall.** A payment below the payoff amount leaves the loan open, with the payment applied normally.
6. **GAP.** A loan that is paid off with GAP coverage in force earns a GAP refund under the GAP refund rule.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical loan)

Principal balance 12000.00; interest accrued through the credit date 43.56; fees due 25.00. The payoff amount is 12000.00 plus 43.56 plus 25.00, that is 12068.56.

| Payment on that credit date | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| 12068.56 | reaches the payoff amount | payoff payment; loan paid off |
| 12100.00 | exceeds it by 31.44 | payoff payment; 31.44 refunded within 5 business days by the same method |
| 12000.00 | falls short | loan stays open; the 12000.00 is applied as a normal payment |

## Points of judgement

**Is the payoff amount the same on every day of a quote?** No. The quote states the amount for one date; the per-diem interest shows how much interest each further day adds.

**Is an excess credited back to the loan?** No. It is refunded to the payer by the method it came from.
